*Vedanāttika, Hetuduka* is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As its title indicates, the section investigates the conditional relations between phenomena classified according to the triad of feeling (*vedanāttika*) cross-referenced with the dyad of causal roots (*hetuduka*) [SuttaCentral].

No distinct English translation or curated external parallels are registered for this section on SuttaCentral, and it receives no dedicated discussion in the provided secondary literature [SuttaCentral].
